name: Deezer
author: Viboplr
description: Artist and album images from Deezer

assistant.instructions: Artist portraits and album covers from Deezer. The chain path (POST /v1/images/{kind} with pluginId=deezer) returns one auto-picked image; search_art returns MULTIPLE candidates with names, so a model can pick the right one (reissues, common names) and hand the url to whatever needs it.

tools.name: search_art
tools.description: Search Deezer for artist portraits or album covers — returns up to `limit` candidates (name + image url) instead of one auto-pick
